notes: Confirmed via notes/242.md (prior Home Decor pass) that India has no dedicated country storefront; Indian shoppers are served the shared 'Rest of World' catalogue at https://www.zarahome.com/ww/ (storeId 88009900, catalogId 80290026 -- verified as the exact match to India's own entry in the site's store-list API, shared with 139 other countries). Accessed entirely via Chrome connector: robots.txt fetched first (no Claude/ClaudeBot disallow, generic User-agent:* rules only). Pulled the store's full category tree via same-origin fetch of itxrest/2/catalog/store/88009900/80290026/category (251 nodes) -- top level is only BEDDING, HOME DECOR, BATHROOM, KIDS AND BABY, CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR, LAUNDRY CARE, CULINARY STORIES (editorial, excluded), +INFO (help/careers pages, excluded), WITHDRAWAL OF ITEMS, SEARCH, ZARA HOME (brand/app/Instagram links). There is NO top-level Furniture department and no Living Room/Bedroom/Dining room departments at all in this WW catalogue -- confirms the prior pass's finding that WW is a heavily reduced international catalogue (it also lacks Lighting, Mirrors and Kitchen & Dining entirely). Regex-scanned all 251 node names for furniture keywords (furniture, sofa, chair, table, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelv, bookcase, seating, armchair, mueble, nightstand, ottoman, headboard, sideboard) -- exactly ONE hit: BEDDING > DRESSING ROOM > 'Furniture' (internal category id 1020742394, key E-I-A_D_VESTIDOR_MUEBLES = Spanish 'dressing room furniture'). Verified this node has 0 products via itxrest product API (category/1020742394/product returned productIds: []). Also cross-checked the ww category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-ww-0.xml.gz, 460 URLs, decompressed via DecompressionStream in-tab) for furniture-shaped slugs -- confirms only the Dressing Room branch is furniture-adjacent (dressing-room-n2463, dressing-room-all-n5640); no separate furniture URL is indexed there. Located the node's live canonical URL by opening the rendered Dressing Room page (https://www.zarahome.com/ww/dressing-room-n2463) and finding its 'Furniture' tab link, which resolves to https://www.zarahome.com/ww/furniture-n4104?celement=1020742394 -- canonical link tag confirms https://www.zarahome.com/ww/furniture-n4104. Direct navigation to that canonical URL WITHOUT the celement query param 404s to /ww/error.html (an orphaned node not independently routable -- the celement context from its parent is required), but with the celement param it renders 200 with title 'Furniture & Accessories', the correct h1/breadcrumb 'BEDDING > DRESSING ROOM > FURNITURE', and the site's own marketing copy for the category, but zero product tiles in the grid (0 ADD-to-basket buttons, 0 price strings) -- matching the API's empty productIds. This is therefore a genuine live, indexed, correctly-routed furniture category with a real product count of zero, not a broken/absent node, so it is emitted per the live-0-products rule rather than omitted. No other furniture-typed nodes exist anywhere in Bedding, Home Decor, Bathroom or Kids & Baby (all subcategory names for those four departments were enumerated and inspected by eye; none reference furniture-type products -- only bed linen, bath accessories, storage baskets, cushions, throws, kids bedding/bathroom etc., all correctly out of scope). Sanity checks: qty=0 confirmed two independent ways (structured productIds array + rendered grid emptiness); node is reachable only via its parent's tab (celement param), consistent with the WW catalogue's severely pruned tree seen elsewhere in this store (same pattern as the Lighting/Mirror/Kitchen&Dining ids the prior pass found 200-with-zero-products for this same store/catalog). DUPLICATE-COMPANY NOTE (carried from notes/242.md): /ww/ serves 140 countries under the identical storeId/catalogId pair; if any other project SR targets a country from that shared list, its furniture result should read identically to this one.
